_comment: Restroom sign manifest with two kinds of signs. (1) DRAWINGS, PLACEHOLDER VALUES: the twelve SVG icons (sets classic to twins) are original drawings made for this project (scripts/draw-restroom-samples.mjs); their `mock` values and their similarities (sameSet, crossSet, defaultCross, jitter) are invented so Compare and Match give stable, sensible demo results, not model outputs. (2) REAL SIGNS, REAL MODEL OUTPUTS: the twelve ioai-v<n>.webp signs (sets ioai-*) are door signs from the IOAI 2025 Restroom validation set (n = gallery file number), resized to at most 256 px and saved as WebP, otherwise unchanged. Their `mock` values and every entry in `similarity.pairs` were returned by the model service in api/ (POST /restroom/compare) for these exact files, on 11 November 2026, with the default restroom model it reports as clip-vitb32-zs (zero-shot CLIP ViT-B-32, no fine-tuned weights, no probe). A real sign next to a drawing gets an invented crossSet/defaultCross value, because a real model cannot read SVG. IOAI 2025 data is CC-BY-4.0: keep the attribution in web/README.md, web/lib/credits.ts and on the About page.

similarity._comment: Mock similarity, the same 0..1 scale as the model ((cos + 1) / 2), set to the range measured on the IOAI training restrooms (two doors of one restroom: median 0.94; signs of two different restrooms: median 0.84). Two signs of one set get sameSet[set]. Two signs of different sets get crossSet['a|b'] (set ids in alphabetical order) or defaultCross, plus a fixed jitter of at most ±jitter derived from the two sample ids, so values look less uniform but never change. `pairs` overrides everything for a specific pair ('idA|idB', alphabetical); it holds the real model similarity of every pair of IOAI signs.

sets.note: Tricky: both figures wear trousers; the female one only has a ponytail, so both read as male.
